snippet.title: Sacrificio | Horror Game Awards SUMMER SHOWCASE WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
Hired to save a priest from a ruthless and sadistic vampire, a lone bounty hunter sets out on a journey to a cursed land, haunted by terrible creatures of the night.

The lone gunslinger quickly discovers the horrible truth that people there are treated as livestock, preyed upon by supernatural evil. The worst among these monsters is an imprisoned vampire, who commands his vermin to hunt down unsuspecting villagers so that he may feast upon their blood.

This arduous task will send the young gunslinger into an unforgiving fight for survival, making him question if hope can be found in such a place and if his strict morality can survive in such desperate times.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3228790/Sacrificio/?l=french

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
